meta.title: Fill Notifications & Paper Trading Mode
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement fill notifications and paper trading mode for live and simulated trading support.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Fill notifications received in live mode via polling or WebSocket
Paper trading mode: orders NOT sent to Lighter.xyz, simulated fills generated locally
Paper mode uses real market prices from Lighter.xyz for realistic fills

key-tasks.task: Implement simulated fills with real market prices and configurable slippage

architecture-context.pattern: Paper mode reuses PaperBroker patterns but with Lighter.xyz prices. Simulated fills use real market prices with configurable slippage.

technical-specifications.spec:
async def _submit_paper_order(self, asset, amount, order_type, limit_price): market_price = await self.get_current_price(asset) self._paper_order_counter += 1 order_id = f"PAPER-{self._paper_order_counter:06d}"
if order_type == "market": slippage = Decimal("0.001") # 0.1% side = "buy" if amount > 0 else "sell" fill_price = market_price * (1 + slippage) if side == "buy" else market_price * (1 - slippage) else: fill_price = limit_price
fill_data = { "order_id": order_id, "fill_price": fill_price, "fill_quantity": abs(amount), "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), } logger.info("paper_trade_executed", order_id=order_id, symbol=asset.symbol, ...) await self._on_fill(fill_data) return order_id
